svg.title: Lyre-harp frame, 188 x 400mm
svg.desc: Drawing for review, not a cut file. 1 unit = 1mm. Drawn from lyre_harp.py's build(), the geometry the cut files in lyre-harp-bore30-188x400mm/ come from.
svg.text: Lyre-harp frame, 188 x 400mm, drawn from lyre_harp.py: the same build() as the cut files.
Solid: the cheek's two rims as cut. Dotted blue: the faces the air touches.
The duct is 30mm deep throughout, 30mm wide over the arch and down the sides (36mm outside),
and opens below the hole into the resonator.
Sound hole: the 2-lead 7-bight knot, r30, front cheek only, centred on the axis 2/3 up the resonator.
Hitch-pin block: 6 laminations, 30mm wide against the bottom wall over 8 facets; 7 2mm hitch pins 16mm apart.
Tuning-pin block: 6 laminations filling the duct at the arch, one tuning pin above each hitch pin.
